[EN] The sikandaris wish to regain control of their Hatchery and we'll oblige them.

Killian brought in some ebon fimbrilisks, probably to keep the argons and the sikandaris in line, and they must die.

With the fimbrilisks dead, we can work on clearing out the argons.
[ES] Los sikandaris desean recuperar el control de su Hatchery y nosotros los complaceremos.

Killian trajo algunos ebon fimbrilisks, probablemente para mantener a raya a los argons y a los sikandaris, y deben morir.

Con los fimbrilisks muertos, podemos trabajar en limpiar a los argons.

[EN] We must hope the sikandaris recognize we're taking the high road, helping them in spite of what they did to us.

The goal had better be worth the price.
[ES] Debemos esperar que los sikandaris reconozcan que estamos tomando el camino correcto, ayudándolos a pesar de lo que nos hicieron.

Más vale que el objetivo valga la pena.
